_comment: The CPG's port: what the oscillator hands DOWN to the muscles — the phase signal that becomes the drive. This is the bridge from the derivation to the trainable controller.

hands_down.phi_L: left-leg oscillator phase, advances at omega_swing = 4.170 rad/s
hands_down.phi_R: right-leg phase, locked antiphase (phi_R = phi_L + pi)
hands_down.drive: muscle activation = f(phi) mapped through the synergy basis (16 dims)
hands_down.reset: heel-strike contact event resets phi (sensory entrainment)

note: Where the story reconnects to training: the CPG state augments the policy. periodicity -> 1.0 is the falsifiable witness.
